issues.quote: All other pages have a self-referencing canonical; this one does not.
`/shop/` canonicalises to `/coffee/`
The wholesale page is set to `noindex` while sitting in the sitemap and the main nav.
`/subscriptions/` and `/coffee/` share the same title
The title is ... about 88 characters, which will be truncated in results.
No `<meta name="description">`.
links to `/coffee/aceh-gayo/` (HTTP 404)
It is linked only from the sitemap.
`Disallow: /assets/css/`.
Sitemap contains a URL that returns 404
The page has two H2s ... and no H1.

`

Coffee brewing guide

` and later `

Brew methods

`.
`` has no `alt`.
The hero image ... is 1,818,123 bytes (about 1.8MB)
The cold brew post is a single paragraph of about 80 words
The Product JSON-LD has no `name` property.
The JSON-LD has two questions ... but the page has no visible FAQ section.
Both target "pour over coffee" for beginners.
The URL, title ... and H1 ... say 2024, but ... `dateModified` is 2026-09-01.

wrong_findings.claim: The Bali Kintamani and Java Ijen product pages have valid Product and Offer markup.
wrong_findings.why_wrong: Bali Kintamani's Product JSON-LD is missing the required `name` property; the audit itself later identifies this omission.

geo_advice.advice: Add visible FAQ questions and answers to help AI answers.
geo_advice.quote: Either add the questions and answers to the page body as a visible FAQ (useful for users and for AI answers) or remove the schema.

extra_true.finding: The /coffee/ and /shop/ pages overlap and are thin category listings.
The sitemap has no lastmod values.
The site lacks cafe-specific LocalBusiness structured data; the homepage only has Organization data.
The best-coffee-beans article's Article schema headline differs from its H1 and title.
The Flores Bajawa product page has no Product schema.
The Bali Kintamani and Java Ijen schema offers omit the listed 1kg bag offers.
The blog index is a bare list without dates, excerpts, or categories.
The Article schema on three blog posts lacks image, publisher, mainEntityOfPage, and author URL properties.
The site has no declared favicon, and /favicon.ico returns 404 according to the audit.
The pages lack Open Graph and Twitter Card tags.
The homepage body lacks links to subscriptions, shop, visit, and Flores Bajawa.
The site lacks WebSite schema and testimonials or reviews.
Product and blog pages lack breadcrumbs; the audit also recommends visible breadcrumbs.
The /coffee/ and cold-brew meta descriptions are shorter than the audit's preferred target.
Missing URLs return a bare server-default 404 page.

notes: All 20 planted issues are found. Total is approximate and counts distinct problems once; extra true findings are listed separately.
